data.description:
Agivant's Databricks practice gives AI agents the one thing that makes their answers trustworthy: real business context. As a Databricks Bronze Partner, Agivant builds agents that reason over governed data and show results in days and weeks.

Built on the Databricks Data + AI Platform, with Lakebase Postgres, Unity Catalog, and Genie, Agivant moves teams from isolated pilots to production agents that act safely on real business questions.

blocks.quote: The biggest limiting factor for enterprise AI right now is not intelligence, it is context. Models are capable, but most organizations still cannot connect them reliably to the data and business logic that make an answer trustworthy. Databricks has been building toward a platform where governed data and agents work together as a single foundation, and that matches exactly what we see with our own clients. As a Databricks Bronze Partner, Agivant is focused on helping enterprises turn that foundation into production AI systems that create measurable business value.

paragraphs: Amp’d by Agivant is our accelerated approach to building production AI agents on Databricks.

Our Forward Deployed Engineers work directly with business and technology teams to turn high-value workflows into production agents using the latest Databricks capabilities, from **Agent Bricks and Genie Agents to Unity Catalog, Lakebase, MLflow and AI Gateway.**
Every engagement produces reusable agent patterns, governed data assets, evaluation frameworks and deployment components that accelerate the next use case.

data.heading: Give every agent the business context to answer with confidence.
data.description: Agivant combines Genie Ontology, Genie Agents, Agent Bricks and Unity Catalog to ground agents in the business context behind enterprise data, from trusted definitions of revenue, risk, and customer to the relationships and workflows that connect them.
data.closingStatement: When agents can reason over the same governed data and business context the organization runs on, the next question is who watches them.

blocks.title: Genie Ontology
blocks.body: gives agents a shared understanding of business entities, relationships, metrics, and terminology.

blocks.title: Agent Bricks
blocks.body: enables domain-specific agents to reason over governed enterprise data and execute business workflows.

blocks.title: Genie Agents
blocks.body: turn natural-language business questions into governed, actionable insights directly on enterprise data.

blocks.title: Lakebase
blocks.body: brings operational and transactional context alongside analytical data, giving agents a more complete view of the business.

data.heading: Keep cost, access, and agent behavior under clear control
data.description: Agivant uses **Unity Catalog, AI Gateway, MLflow, and Databricks’ built-in governance capabilities** to control what agents can access, which models and tools they can use, and how they behave in production. Evaluation and observability help teams continuously measure agent quality, while human checkpoints and policy-driven guardrails keep high-impact decisions under control.
